per_rule.rule: S_N must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty.
S_N must not be null.
Every S_N in Cust_Bio_dirty must exist in Acc_Info_dirty.S_N.
Account_No must be stored as a 4-digit identifier consisting of exactly four digits.
Account_No must not be null.
Name must not be null.
Name should follow normal personal-name casing; words should not be fully lowercase or fully uppercase except for known particles such as bin, binte, d/o, and s/o.
ID_No must follow the dominant format of one leading letter, followed by 7 digits, followed by one trailing letter.
ID_No must not be null.
Race must use the approved canonical values Chinese, Malay, or Indian.
Race must not be null.
Gender must use the approved canonical values Male or Female.
Gender must not be null.
Age must be parseable as a numeric value.
Age must be between 0 and 120 inclusive.
Age should be at least 13 for this consumer/account-based service dataset.
Contact_No must not be null.

Contact_No must be a valid Singapore phone number: only digits, spaces, hyphens, parentheses, or a leading plus are allowed; numbers may appear as local 8-digit numbers or with country code 65, and the local part should be 8 digits.
Email must match a basic email structure with exactly one @ symbol and no whitespace.
Email must not be null.
Country must use the approved canonical value Singapore.
Country must not be null.
Street_Name must not be null.
Street_Name should use normal street-name casing rather than all-uppercase text.
Postal_Code must be exactly 6 digits.
Postal_Code must not be null.
If Name contains the particle 'Bin' or 's/o', Gender must be Male; if Name contains 'Binte' or 'd/o', Gender must be Female.
If Street_Name is populated, Postal_Code must also be populated.
When Country is Singapore, Postal_Code must be a 6-digit Singapore postal code.
For the same S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.Account_No must match Acc_Info_dirty.Account_No exactly.
For the same S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.ID_No must match Acc_Info_dirty.ID exactly.
For the same S_N, Cust_Bio_dirty.Name should represent the same person as Acc_Info_dirty.Full_Name, allowing only casing differences but not different names or truncation.
Account_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
ID_No must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
Email must be unique within Cust_Bio_dirty
